entities.name: Ambrosio de Funes Villalpando
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ambrosio de Funes Villalpando, was a captain general of Cuba, from July 1763 to June 1765. Prior to that, he had represented Spain at the court of the Russian Empire.
